en: The postcard image depicts a small church with a pointed bell tower, the Madonna delle Grazie, surrounded by trees and set against a backdrop of hills or mountains. Several people, including children, can be seen in front of the church on what appears to be a pleasantly landscaped area. The text 'MADONNA DELLE GRAZIE (Folgaria)' is printed at the bottom, with a handwritten message running vertically along the right side.
